metadata.title: Dirichlet eigenvalue asymptotics on conformally compact Einstein manifolds
metadata.abstract: We study the first Dirichlet eigenvalues of large geodesic balls and fixed-width boundary layers on conformally compact Einstein manifolds of dimension $n+1.$ For large balls, we determine the exponential rate of convergence when the spectral bottom is less than $\frac{n^2}{4},$ i.e. the bottom of the continuous spectrum. When it equals the bottom of the continuous spectrum, the second coefficient has two possible values, according to whether the continued resolvent is regular or has a pole there. We also give examples with negative Yamabe conformal infinity realizing both threshold alternatives and construct metrics with a Ricci lower bound that have other second coefficients. Under nonnegative Yamabe conformal infinity, we also find the exact second coefficient for the nonlinear $p$-Laplacian on large balls. For layers defined by a geodesic boundary defining function, we compute the first correction and show that its sign characterizes nonnegative Yamabe conformal infinity.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 无穷远 Dirichlet 谱渐近
analysis.workSummary: 研究共形紧 Einstein 流形大测地球及定宽边界层的首特征值，刻画低于连续谱底时的指数收敛率及阈值处由 resolvent 正则或极点决定的两个次阶系数。
techniques: 共形无穷远 Yamabe 类型
analysis.breakthrough: 区分 Einstein 结构下的两种阈值行为，并给出 p-Laplacian 和边界层推广。
analysis.limitations: 不同算子和边界层的系数使用不同假设；仅 Ricci 下界可产生其他系数。 已补读 Theorem 1.1、Remark 1.2 与反例适用范围。核对了低于谱阈值的指数衰减与阈值处 π²、π²/4 两种 R⁻² 系数的区分；非 Einstein 的反例可有其他系数，不能并入 Einstein 二分结论。未逐步核验散射与阈值共振分析。
analysis.aiEvidence: 披露 GPT-6 Astra 协助反例计算、主定理证明细节及语言排版，并明确将 Remark 2.3 的两个测试函数构造归给 AI，产生 Lemma 2.2 的另一证明。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.28995v1 · PDF 第 33 页 Declaration of AI use

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。披露 GPT-6 Astra 协助反例计算、主定理证明细节及语言排版，并明确将 Remark 2.3 的两个测试函数构造归给 AI，产生 Lemma 2.2 的另一证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 渐近双曲谱几何的精细定量结果。
